summary: Ping An Biomedical Co., Ltd., a Hong Kong-domiciled Nasdaq-listed foreign private issuer (PASW), filed a Form 6-K disclosing that on November 4, 2026 it entered a definitive patent transfer and purchase agreement with Future Biotechnology Group Co., Limited to acquire three tumor cell-related medical technology patents covering oncology diagnosis and treatment, cell detection and bioengineering, and biomarker and DNA probe technologies for aggregate consideration of US$2.3 million. The deal follows an October 22, 2026 letter of intent. Closing is subject to satisfaction of all conditions in the agreement and applicable registration procedures; no board recommendation, advisor, premium or outside date is disclosed. The filing also notes continuing negotiations over a proposed strategic investment in the same counterparty. Watch closing conditions and any related-party overlap with that pending investment.
